name: GitHub Dark High Contrast
tagline: Pure black paper, pure white ink, and a floor no other theme in this repo clears.
notes: Holds AAA on every ink slot, which makes it the most readable theme in the collection -- Blueprint had to lighten its red to reach 7.04, and this one arrives there without being asked.

contrast_exempt.muted: ANSI 8 is GitHub's own dimmed-text value and dimmed text is supposed to recede; lifting it would mean shipping a terminal palette GitHub does not have (measures 3.87:1)
